messages.subject: Re: [RBigData] Installing pbdR on Windows 10
messages.body_plain:
Hi Cristina,

Thanks for your response.

I am going through the guide.

I've taken the following steps:

1. I've installed R-3.2.2 and Rtools version 3.3.0.1958

2. Install MS-MPI

I've got this site (https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb524831(v=vs.85).aspx) from the link (Download Microsoft MPI, MS-MPI, (HPC Pack 2012 R2 MS-MPI Redistributable Package) from Microsoft Developer Network <http://http/www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/> or here <http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb524831%28v=vs.85%29.aspx>; )

The above address from  here <http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb524831%28v=vs.85%29.aspx>.

In this page, it says

MS-MPI downloads

The following are current downloads for MS-MPI:
MS-MPI v6 <http://go.microsoft.com/FWLink/p/?LinkID=389556> (new!) - see also the Release Notes <https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/mt147726(v=vs.85).aspx>
Debugger for MS-MPI Applications with HPC Pack 2012  <http://go.microsoft.com/FWLink/p/?LinkID=390711>R2
Should I need to install both (the two dot points).

Please guide me.

Regards,

Deb

messages.body_plain:
Hi Cristina,

I forget to mention two points given in the microsoft site for MS-MPI installation.

I am on Windows 10 64 bit.

The System Requirements:

1. MS-MPI v6

·        Supported Operating System

·        Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows Server 2012, Windows Server 2012 R2

·        Windows 8.1, Windows 8, Windows 7, Windows Vista, Windows Server 2012 R2, Windows Server 2012, Windows Server 2008 R2, Windows Server 2008

2. Debugger for MS-MPI Applications with HPC Pack 2012 R2

Supported Operating System

Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows Server 2012, Windows Server 2012 R2

MS-MPI v6 or later

Once again, thank you very much for the time you have given.

Regards,

Deb
